title: Wake, command, silence, task, back to listening
scenario: 'Hey Neko' then 1.5 s of speech and 1.2 s of silence (synthetic frames, fake ASR returns 'open notepad').
expected: Exactly one task 'open notepad' submitted; state back to wake_listening; the words are not kept in the outcome.

title: Every cancel phrase cancels
scenario: Commands 'cancel', 'never mind', 'forget it', 'nothing', 'no thanks', 'quiet'.
expected: No task for any of them; one cancellation each.

title: 'Stop' while a task runs stops it
scenario: A task is running and the command is 'stop'.
expected: stop() called once; nothing submitted.

title: Neko's own voice cannot wake it
scenario: Detections while Neko is speaking (echo of its own voice).
expected: Ignored: no recording, no speech recognition call, no task.

title: No speech after the wake word: no recognition call
scenario: Wake word, then 5.3 s of silence.
expected: Back to listening after 5 s; speech recognition never called (nothing recorded is sent anywhere).

title: Speech recognition down is reported, listening resumes
scenario: The local speech service fails.
expected: No task; outcome reports the failure; state wake_listening.

title: A command is cut at 12 s
scenario: 15 s of continuous speech after the wake word.
expected: Recognition receives at most 12 s + 2 s pre-roll; one task.

title: Detector crash restarts it
scenario: The keyword detector raises (as N.E.K.O's does on WAKE_WORD_TIMEOUT).
expected: One error counted, detector restarted, back to wake_listening.

title: Paused microphone is ignored; resume works
scenario: Paused (POST /pause) during a full wake + command; then resumed.
expected: Nothing submitted while paused (status says paused); after resume the next command is submitted.

title: Two cancels from the screen are one cancel
scenario: POST /cancel twice while a command is being recorded.
expected: One cancellation, no task, back to listening.

title: A second wake word during a command does not double the task
scenario: The detector fires again while the command is recorded.
expected: Exactly one task.

title: Status never shows what was said
scenario: A command with private words.
expected: The status JSON (served to the Neko icon) contains none of the words.

title: 44.1 kHz microphones are resampled to 16 kHz
scenario: 1 s of 44.1 kHz audio.

title: State machine keeps up with real time
scenario: Per-frame processing time of the loop (fakes for detector/VAD).
expected: Under 5 ms per 40 ms frame.

title: Status server: loopback only, foreign web pages refused
scenario: The status/control server is asked from loopback and with a foreign Origin.
expected: Loopback answered; foreign origins refused (no web page can cancel or pause).

title: A long sentence starting with 'stop' is a task when nothing runs
scenario: 'stop the music and open notepad' with no task running.
expected: Submitted as a task, not swallowed as a cancel.

title: Wake recall at 0.5 m, owner's voice
scenario: 10 x 'Hey Neko' by the owner at 0.5 m (physical hardware).
expected: Measured on the laptop; DEFERRED — OWNER HARDWARE REQUIRED.

title: Wake recall at 1.5 m, owner's voice
scenario: 10 x 'Hey Neko' at 1.5 m (physical hardware).
expected: Measured on the laptop; DEFERRED — OWNER HARDWARE REQUIRED.

title: False wakes in a normal room
scenario: hours of ambient audio and TV (physical hardware).
expected: Measured on the laptop; DEFERRED — OWNER HARDWARE REQUIRED.

title: Cancel by voice, real microphone
scenario: owner says 'cancel' after the wake word (physical hardware).
expected: Measured on the laptop; DEFERRED — OWNER HARDWARE REQUIRED.

title: Barge-in while Neko speaks
scenario: owner interrupts Neko's speech (physical hardware).
expected: Measured on the laptop; DEFERRED — OWNER HARDWARE REQUIRED.

title: No self-wake from the speakers
scenario: Neko's TTS through speakers into the microphone (physical hardware).
expected: Measured on the laptop; DEFERRED — OWNER HARDWARE REQUIRED.

title: Speech recognition word error rate, owner
scenario: owner's real commands in English and Telugu (physical hardware).
expected: Measured on the laptop; DEFERRED — OWNER HARDWARE REQUIRED.
